newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Embraer mulls making new jets.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Embraer mulls making new jets.

text.p: Brazilian aircraft manufacturer Embraer said it is conducting market studies on the production of 37 and 70-seat jets.
"We are studying the production of two new types of jets which will be sold to regional carriers," said a company spokeswoman, who asked not to be named.
The study is expected to be completed in the second half of 1997, she added.
Last year, Embraer launched its 50-seat EMB-145 jet. The company has received 62 firm orders and 219 buy options and plans to deliver 33 EMB-145s this year, she said.
The spokeswoman noted that the new jets would be similar to the EMB-145 model but smaller.
Embraer, which is expected to announce 1996 results by the end of the month, posted a nine-month loss of 41.1 million reais, she said.
